brief.zh: 四阶矩只给多项式尾界。尝试把倍增映射分块，估计指数矩；须从实部推广到复模。文献中大值集的方法可供移植。
brief.en: Block the doubling map and control exponential moments, including the passage from real parts to modulus. A fourth moment alone yields only a polynomial tail.
